rules.name: cs-22-zero-lot-legs-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT derivative_type, count(*) AS legs, sum(CASE WHEN contract_number IS NULL OR contract_number = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS without_contract_number, sum(CASE WHEN contract_number IS NOT NULL AND contract_number <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_contract_number FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE active_lots = 0 GROUP BY derivative_type

SELECT trade_id, contract_number, client_code, derivative_type, instrument, subportfolio, transaction_date, traded_price, active_lots, settle_price, future_price, mtm_usd, netting_status FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE active_lots = 0 AND contract_number IS NOT NULL AND contract_number <> '' ORDER BY contract_number

SELECT business_unit, count(*) AS rows_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active_lots <> 0) AS nonzero, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active_lots = 0) AS zero_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY business_unit ORDER BY rows_total DESC

SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.instrument, d.subportfolio, d.transaction_date, d.premium, l.active_lots, d.netting_status, d.netting_date FROM opera.latest_active_lot l JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d ON d.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND d.business_unit = l.business_unit AND d.trade_id = l.trade_id AND d.is_latest_version = 1 WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = 'CFS' AND l.active_lots = 0 AND d.contract_number IS NOT NULL AND d.contract_number <> '' AND d.netting_status <> 'fully_netted' ORDER BY d.contract_number

expect.reason: counts of zero-lot legs in the legacy cache
